title: ARPANET 歷史網路架構
summary: 以封包交換、分層協議與歷史遷移串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect packet switching, layered protocols and historical transitions with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 歷史與需求
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「歷史與需求」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop history and needs through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retrospectives and contemporary protocols provide different evidence. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 玩具 50 kbit/s 鏈路傳送 1000 bytes，序列化時間 8000/50000=0.16 s。若儲存轉發經三條同速鏈路、不重疊且每段傳播20 ms，單包總下限=3×(160+20)=540 ms；未含排隊，不代表 ARPANET 的實測時延。
